title: Science: Being Healthy 🍎
summary:
1. Healthy Diet & Water:
To keep our bodies healthy, we need to eat a healthy diet and drink plenty of water.

2. Exercise, Rest & Sleep:
🏃‍♀️ Exercise: When we exercise, our heart beats faster, we breathe faster, and we sweat.
🛌 Rest & Sleep: After an active day, our body needs enough rest and sleep to get its energy back.

3. Our Teeth:
We use our teeth to chew food. There are 3 types of teeth:
🦷 Incisors: To cut food.
🧛 Canines: To tear food.
🍔 Molars: To chew and grind food.
A newborn baby has no teeth. Young children have milk teeth. When they grow older, these fall out and are replaced by permanent teeth.

4. Keeping Clean:
To stay healthy, we must wash and bathe, brush our teeth, and cut our nails.

5. Are you ill?:
Having a fever or a bad cough are signs of illness. Wear a mask when you are ill so germs do not spread!

questions.questionText: Select the correct words: We can take care of our teeth by brushing them...
questions.hint: You should brush your teeth in the morning and before bed!

questions.questionText: What happens to our body when we do EXERCISE (like running and jumping)?
options: Our heart beats faster and we sweat
questions.answer: Our heart beats faster and we sweat
questions.hint: Think about how you feel after running around the playground.

questions.questionText: Are you ill? Which of these is a SIGN OF ILLNESS?
options: Having a fever and a cough
questions.answer: Having a fever and a cough
questions.hint: These signs show that your body is fighting germs.

questions.questionText: Match the types of teeth with their jobs!
questions.hint: Incisors are at the front, canines are sharp, and molars are big teeth at the back.
